data.name: Ghannam
data.gender_notes: Ghannam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Ghannam means 'traveller' or 'journey'. This name holds a significant connection with the spiritual journey of life, signifying a continuous quest towards knowledge, growth, and self-improvement in Islam. The name Ghannam carries the meaning “Traveller, Journey” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghannam usually hope their child will grow to embody traveller, journey and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes endurance and strength, as well as abundance and prosperity
data.etymology: Ghannam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Traveller, Journey.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghannam total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: غنام
in_arabic.meaning: غنام يعني الشخص الذي يملك الغنم الكثير أو يرعاها
in_arabic.long_meaning: غنام هو اسم مشتق من كلمة غنم، وهو يعني الشخص الذي يملك الغنم الكثير أو يرعاها. في اللغة العربية، الغنم هو مصدر للرزق والثروة. وقد وردت كلمة غنم في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ أَندَادًا يُحِبُّونَهُم كَحُبِّ اللَّهِ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَشَدُّ حُبًّا لِلَّهِ' (البقرة: 165)، حيث يمكن تفسير الأنداد هنا بأنهم كالأغنام التي تتخذ للتدجين والتربية. يعتبر اسم غنام من الأسماء ذات المعنى الجميل والدلالة القوية في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: غنام
in_urdu.meaning: غنام کا مطلب ہے جس شخص کے پاس بہت ساری بکریاں ہوں
in_urdu.long_meaning: غنام ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے جس شخص کے پاس بہت ساری بکریاں ہوں یا وہ بکریوں کا مالک ہو. یہ نام بحرین، مصر، لبنان، فلسطین، اردن، سوریه، ترکی، اور پاکستان میں مسلمانوں کے لیے ایک اہم نام ہے. اسلامی ثقافت میں، غنام کا نام اچھے معنی رکھتا ہے اور اس کا تعلق حیوانات کی دیکھ بھال اور رزق کی فراوانی سے ہے.

in_hindi.name: घनाम
in_hindi.meaning: घनाम का अर्थ है जिसके पास बहुत सारी बकरियाँ हों
in_hindi.long_meaning: घनाम एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है जिसके पास बहुत सारी बकरियाँ हों या वह बकरियों का मालिक हो। इस नाम का महत्व इस्लामी संस्कृति में बहुत अधिक है और यह नाम पाकिस्तान, भारत, बांग्लादेश और अन्य दक्षिण एशियाई देशों में मुसलमानों के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण नाम है। इस नाम का अर्थ शुभ है और यह नाम पशुओं की देखभाल और धन की प्रचुरता से जुड़ा है।

in_pashto.name: غنام
in_pashto.meaning: غنام د دې معنی دی چې کوم سړی ډیرې پسونه لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: غنام د عربي ژبې يو نوم دی چې معنی يې دى کوم سړی ډیرې پسونه لري يا د پسونو مالک دی. دا نوم د افغانستان، پاکستان، او نورو پښتوخېلو هېوادونو کې د مسلمانانو لپاره يو مهم نوم دی. په اسلامي کلتور کې، غنام نوم ښه معنی لري او د حيواناتو د پاملرنې او د رزق د کثرت سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Ghannam
in_english.meaning: One who owns or takes care of many sheep or goats
in_english.long_meaning: Ghannam is an Arabic name derived from the root 'غ-ن-م' which means 'to possess' or 'to take care of sheep or goats'. The name Ghannam holds significant meaning in Islamic tradition and is associated with the responsibility of taking care of livestock, symbolizing abundance, and provision. It reflects positive qualities such as leadership, care, and generosity. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, including Arab, Turkish, and South Asian communities.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ghannam holds cultural significance as it is connected to the traditional Islamic notion of travel and exploration. The concept of travel in Islamic culture embodies the spirit of adventure, growth, and new experiences. It reflects the historical context of the Islamic golden age, where scholars travelled vast distances to acquire knowledge from various scholars and centers of learning. Therefore, the name 'Ghannam' serves as a reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge and experiencing new cultures.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ghannam represents the journey of self-development and growth towards Allah. The Islamic faith emphasizes the constant pursuit of knowledge and bettering oneself as a means of drawing closer to Allah. Thus, the name 'Ghannam' symbolizes the pilgrimage towards a more pious and righteous life, with a continued focus on personal and spiritual growth, humility, and devotion. Through this introspective journey, the individual comes closer to achieving a deeper understanding of themselves, Allah, and the world around them.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Kathir records in his 'Al-Bidāyah wa-l-Nihāyah' that Ghannam ibn Sa'id Al-Khuzai was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). He is reported to have led the Muslim army against the Byzantines (Roman Empire) and defeated them in the Battle of Mu'tah in 629 AD.
historical_references.context: Battle of Mu'tah against the Byzantines

historical_references.reference: Al-Tabari in his 'History of the Prophets and Kings' mentions that Ghannam ibn Talib was a leader of the Arab tribes who supported Ali ibn Abi Talib during the First Fitnah (civil war) following the death of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). He was one of the signatories of the Constitution of Medina and played a significant role in defending Ali against Mu'awiya's forces in the Battle of Siffin in 657 AD.
historical_references.context: First Fitnah and Battle of Siffin

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Ghannam' has gained modern popularity in the context of Islamic culture, Middle Eastern cuisine, and food blogs. It refers to a traditional Middle Eastern dish made from marinated lamb or mutton that is cooked on skewers over an open flame. The dish is popular in countries such as Syria, Lebanon, and Jordan, and is often served with rice, pita bread, and various sauces. On Instagram, users share photos of beautifully presented Ghannam dishes, using hashtags like #ghannam and #meatonsticks. On Pinterest, there are numerous boards dedicated to Middle Eastern food and Ghannam is a common search term. On YouTube, there are many videos demonstrating how to make Ghannam at home, with various recipes and cooking techniques. Overall, the name 'Ghannam' represents a rich cultural heritage and a delicious culinary tradition that continues to be celebrated and shared through social media and food blogs.
